sentences.en: There is certain to be some opposition to your suggestion.
sentences.zh: 你的建议肯定会遇到一些反对。

sentences.en: He was angry at the suggestion that he was dishonest.
sentences.zh: 他对于有人暗示他不诚实感到很生气。

sentences.en: I'd like to point out some problems regarding your suggestion.
sentences.zh: 我想指出一下你建议中的一些问题。
